title: Replace logo and cover page images with custom uploads

requirements.summary: Replace the current logo image with the uploaded 'baja logo.jpg' (VVCE BAJA shield with red baja vehicle and checkered flags)
acceptanceCriteria: The header logo displays the VVCE BAJA shield design from the uploaded image
Logo maintains proper aspect ratio and sizing in the header
Logo is visible on all pages

file_operations.description: Copy the uploaded 'baja logo.jpg' to the frontend public assets directory as 'baja-logo.jpg' to make it accessible as a static asset throughout the application

Update the header logo img src to reference '/assets/baja-logo.jpg' instead of the current generated logo path. Ensure the alt text reflects 'VVCE BAJA Logo' and verify responsive sizing is maintained for both desktop and mobile views

requirements.summary: Replace the cover page jeep photo with the uploaded 'image page.jpg' (baja vehicle on track with driver)
acceptanceCriteria: The home page hero section displays the baja vehicle racing image instead of the current jeep photo
Image fits properly within the hero section layout

file_operations.description: Copy the uploaded 'image page.jpg' to the frontend public assets directory as 'baja-hero.jpg' to replace the current hero image with the racing baja vehicle photo

Update the hero section background image or img src to reference '/assets/baja-hero.jpg' instead of the current generated hero image path. Ensure the image maintains proper aspect ratio, fits within the hero section layout, and preserves image quality with appropriate object-fit styling
